findings.description: The policy grants all actions for EC2, S3, Lambda, and CloudWatch against every resource in scope ("Resource": "*") to the IAM user. Compromise of this user's access key would provide broad control over compute, serverless, monitoring, and potentially all S3 data accessible in the account, rather than the minimum permissions required.
